game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split ash bricks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > -1; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 4: {'n': -3}; {'n': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from ember hounds in Sulfur Springs: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Divide Or Floor – Sulfur Springs Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
